title: Bomb Bay Doors Drop
name: bomb_bay_doors_drop

video_split.event: bay doors part and ball begins free fall

description: A ball rests centered on two small doors that meet in the middle, set flush into a raised platform with a hole beneath. The two doors swing downward and apart on their outer hinges (like bomb-bay doors), opening a gap; the ball loses its support and falls straight down through the gap to the floor, where it bounces a few decaying times before coming to rest. Nothing remains suspended.
